about: c12/c13 inserts (user on c11: 「還不夠，繼續加」, then reuse existing material for free). Each insert cuts away from a c11 shot and back without moving any c11 cut: the c11 shot keeps its own clock underneath (main.js pickShot), so it resumes where it would have been. A 'take' insert plays a window of an earlier generated take at normal speed (seq.py writes seq/<id>, source SHA-256 checked); a 'still' insert is an approved plate moved by the code camera. Camera [centre x, centre y, zoom] in source px, 'from' -> 'to'. start: 'at_word' [line, word] two frames early like build.py's vocal cuts, or 'at_beat' (index into beats.json). end: the same, or 'cut' (the insert runs into that c11 cut, or c13: into the next insert). Rule (user on the takes): no visible singing mouth, no frown; only hands/profile/eyes/hair/wide/environment moments. 'pips' are picture-in-picture insets (480x270 frames under comp/pip/<id>, drawn on the feed layer by main.js). c13: 'mark': true means the take carries no burned-in platform label (the N takes), so the comp draws the AI mark even at 1.0; 'at_beat' may be a half index (the eighth between two beats). c12's edit: inserts-c12.json.
decision: c12: user 2026-11-03 on c11: 「還不夠，繼續加」 (free reuse). c13: the four paid takes N1-N4 (user 「4 支都生成 (Recommended)」); N2 「合成时裁向手」, N4 「只用前 1 秒当插入镜」 (logs/decisions.md)
